An '''engine coupling''' was an [[Engine/Legends|engine]] component. [[Starship/Legends|Starships]] typically had more than one coupling per ship. The power that flowed through the coupling was regulated by a [[hydrovalve]].<ref name="RPG1" />

While fixing his ship, the ''[[Dorion Discus]]'', after a [[Space warfare/Legends|battle]], the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]] found a faulty hydrovalve attached to the engine couplings. By fixing the hydrovalve, Garnet increased the sublight speed of his vessel.<ref name="RPG1" />
